verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Kit's API can target broadcasts to existing segment/tag ids and its MCP server can turn natural language into broadcast actions, but there is no documented endpoint or MCP capability for creating or defining a new segment from a plain-language audience description. Missing for 10: a segment-creation API endpoint, MCP/agent workflow demonstrating natural-language-to-segment translation, and any example of dynamic segment criteria being set programmatically.
